background_refresh.cadence: feeds.refresh_interval_ms; default 900000 ms, 0 disables background refresh
background_refresh.selection: due subscriptions, oldest attempt first, at most 2 per 10-second tick
background_refresh.isolation: fetch runs on a dedicated scoped thread; the engine mutex is held only for selection and recording
background_refresh.failure: refresh errors are recorded with bounded text; previous entries remain
background_refresh.state: candidate state is preflighted against max_state_bytes before persistence

conditional_refresh.validators: ETag and Last-Modified are bounded (256 bytes, no control bytes) and persisted per subscription
conditional_refresh.request: If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since are sent when validators exist
conditional_refresh.not_modified: 304 retains entries/title, clears the error, updates validators and fetched_at without parsing a body
conditional_refresh.no_validator: 304 without a supplied validator is refused
conditional_refresh.redirect: validators are cleared after a redirect because they belong to the issuing origin

ui_auto_refresh: The Feeds page reloads its own observations every 60 seconds while open, stops on navigation/logout, and keeps the configured cadence note visible.
